sentences.text: In a small town, there is a group of kids.
Their names are Mia, Tom, and Sam.
They love trees, flowers, and animals.
One day, they see trash in the park.
They call it the Green Team.
Mia says, "We need to clean the park!"
"Yes! We can pick up the trash!"
Sam adds, "And we can plant flowers!"
The next day, the Green Team meets at the park.
They find plastic, paper, and cans.
They put everything in the bags.
The flowers are bright and colorful.
People in the town see the clean park.
They want to tell others about nature.
They want to help the Earth.
They want to make a big change.
They want to help everyone care for the Earth.
They want to be heroes for nature!
